basis: Objects with legible or partly legible inscriptions included in Mahadevan's 1977 corpus; not the total of all archaeological finds. Introduction sections 4–6, printed pages 5–7. Site table on p.6, class table on p.7. Primary scan inspected visually at PDF pages 17–18.
blank_cells: Blank class cells are recorded as zero within the M77 table's included corpus. They do not assert absence from the site or later excavations.
other_site_class_locator: Appendix V p.828 identifies Jhukar object 9001, Lohumjodaro 9011, Kot Diji 9051, and Amri 9084–9085; class totals are grouped under Other sites on p.7 and are not resolved here.

index_correction.finding: Numbers in brackets after site names denote legible sign occurrences across all texts, not objects, inscriptions or records. They cannot supply site object-count denominators.
